title: Media
description: Browse, search and reuse the images on your site. Every image needs a description in each language, unless it is only decoration.

picker.label: Image
picker.hint: JPEG, PNG, WebP or AVIF. It is resized and stripped of location and camera data in your browser before it is uploaded.
picker.loadFailed: The images could not be loaded.

rejections.unsupported: Only JPEG, PNG, WebP and AVIF images are accepted.
rejections.too_large: The image is too large, even after resizing. Try a smaller one.
rejections.unreadable: Your browser could not read this image. It may be damaged.

decorative.label: Decorative image
decorative.hint: Screen readers skip it, so it needs no description.

alt.label: Description of the image
alt.hint: Say what the image shows, as you would to someone who can't see it.

upload.heading: New image
upload.description: Choose a file, then describe it for each language.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.description: The image is removed from the library for good. Images that are in use cannot be deleted.

library.heading: Library
library.noMatchDescription: Try another file name or a word from the description.
library.title: Choose an image
library.description: Pick one of the images you uploaded.
library.label: Uploaded images
